evidence.reason: `DEPENDENCY_RE` is the dependency-directive scan, and its alternation enumerates `[Unit]` dependency directives but omits `PropagatesStopTo=` and `StopPropagatedFrom=`. Those are systemd v257 stop-propagation dependencies, so a co-installed unit can stop the selected service without the scan recognizing the relationship and discovery can still report `supported=True`. This is an implementation gap in the existing dependency scan; add both directives to the alternation.
